card: Updates the libmultiprocess subtree to bring in non-Unix platform support and resolve several concurrency bugs, including an IPC disconnect data race found by Antithesis, a socket use-after-free, and file descriptor leaks across concurrent forks. The update also adds serialization support for chrono time points and non-default container allocators and comparators, while CMake is updated to suppress C++23 lambda attribute warnings under Clang in C++20 builds. This unblocks downstream multiprocess efforts, including PRs #10102, #29409, #32387, and #35932.
changed_since_previous: Added suppression for `-Wc++23-extensions` in CMakeLists.txt to handle older Clang versions such as Clang 17 that do not recognise `-Wc++23-lambda-attributes`.
evidence: PR description: 'Fixes a data race between IPC calls running on worker threads and disconnects, found by Antithesis (#349).'
PR description: 'Fixes a use-after-free when a socket disconnects before ConnectStream connects, and leaks and hangs when a client construct() call throws (#298).'
PR description: 'Fixes a race where file descriptors from SpawnProcess could leak into processes forked at the same time by other threads, by clearing FD_CLOEXEC in the child after forking (#311).'
problem: The experimental multiprocess build has concurrency and lifetime bugs under disconnect conditions, including an async disconnect race detected by Antithesis, a socket use-after-free, and fd leaks during concurrent process spawning. Additionally, missing support for non-Unix platforms and missing serialization support for custom container comparators/allocators and chrono types block several downstream multiprocess pull requests.

risk.why: Touches non-default experimental multiprocess code and build warning flags, which cannot affect node consensus or production binaries.

scope_notes: This is primarily a subtree update under `src/ipc/libmultiprocess/`, accompanied by a small `CMakeLists.txt` change that adds warning suppressions for `-Wc++23-lambda-attributes` and `-Wc++23-extensions`.
summary: Updates the `src/ipc/libmultiprocess` subtree to the latest version and suppresses clang warnings for C++23 lambda attributes in C++20 builds in `CMakeLists.txt`. The subtree update introduces non-Unix platform support, fixes multiple concurrency bugs including an IPC disconnect race and a use-after-free, and generalizes stream connection handling. It also expands type serialization capabilities for standard chrono time points and templated containers.
